name: Interest Calculation
definition: Set of parameters used to calculate an interest amount.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Identifies the computation method of accrued interest of the related financial instrument.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Percentage charged for the use of an amount of money, usually expressed at an annual rate. The interest rate is the ratio of the amount of interest paid during a certain period of time compared to the principal amount of the interest bearing financial instrument.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies the type of rate used to calculate the interest.

RelatedIndex.name: Related Index
RelatedIndex.definition: Index rate related to the interest rate of the forthcoming interest payment.

InterestAccrualDate.name: Interest Accrual Date
InterestAccrualDate.definition: Start date used for calculating accrued interest on debt instruments which are being sold between interest payment dates. Often but not always the same as the issue date and the dated date.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: Specifies whether the interest is simple or compounded.

InterestMethod.name: Interest Method
InterestMethod.definition: Indicates whether the interest will be settled in cash or rolled in the existing collateral balance.

CalculationFrequency.name: Calculation Frequency
CalculationFrequency.definition: Specifies the periodicity of the calculation of the interest.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Indicates the calculation date of the interest amount.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of an interest payment.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest resulting from the interest calculation.

InterestPeriod.name: Interest Period
InterestPeriod.definition: Period during which the interest rate has been applied.

VariableInterest.name: Variable Interest
VariableInterest.definition: Specifies the parameters to be used for variable interest payments.

RateValidityRange.name: Rate Validity Range
RateValidityRange.definition: Specifies the amount range for which the interest rate is applicable.

DebtInstrument.name: Debt Instrument
DebtInstrument.definition: Debt for which a next interest is specified.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Specifies the difference between two interests.

RelatedInterestManagement.name: Related Interest Management
RelatedInterestManagement.definition: Interest management process which requires interest calculation.
